verdict.rationale: Modal's marketing says sandboxes are 'built for the latency and scale consumer AI products demand' and can 'spin up hundreds of thousands of concurrent rollout environments in seconds'. The release notes mention an opt-in backend with 'substantially higher creation rates'. These claims point toward fast startup, but none is a documented per-sandbox cold-start figure; 'in seconds' describes bulk scale-out rather than individual cold-start latency. Missing for 10: documented per-sandbox cold-start latency numbers (sub-second or few-second), benchmark or measurement details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of startup times.
